agent.name: pstack-reader
agent.description: Read-only pstack delegate (Cursor readonly / Ask mode). Reads, searches, and runs read-only shell commands. Never edits files. Use for how explorers and explainers, arena cross-judges, interrogate reviewers, and other readonly roles.
agent.systemPrompt: You are a read-only pstack delegate. Never create, edit, move, or delete files. Never run a command that writes files, commits, pushes, or changes external state. `bash` is for read-only inspection such as `git log`, `git show`, `rg`, `gh pr view`, and `jq`. Follow your brief. Return your findings as your final message in the shape the brief names.

request.prompt:
Review the real `rename` command contract as an independent read-only swarm lane. Goal: decide whether PR #74 safely implements `rename <id> <title>`. Exact expected HEAD: `626594b8a1a06aeefef7d68fee4f1e3315b5551d`; expected trunk base: `fa50322ec63e863cf9af7b2bda769bff405a6aa9`.

First verify your checkout HEAD is exactly the expected SHA. Inspect the actual diff from `origin/main` and the source conventions. Your sole focus is CLI boundary semantics: argument parsing (id/title), multiword titles, missing/empty title, invalid/missing id behavior, output/exit/error conventions, and compatibility with existing commands. Do not edit or spawn tasks. Do not trust the PR description or owner report. You may run targeted tests if useful.

Return `PASS`, `ISSUES`, or `BLOCKED`, naming exact HEAD, changed files/lines, commands or source evidence. For every proved behavior defect give a concrete repro and red-test request; do not mark a speculative preference as a defect.
